about_the_game:
Hello, I'm a big fan of The Great Escape of the Korean TV Show.

A short but painstaking exodus fan game that started with a small fan heart, please play and enjoy it.

Closed space, only one way out.

We recreated the tense mystery of the first episode of The Great Escape of the Korean TV Show with a game.

Players must become participants trapped in mysterious places, collect clues, solve strange puzzles, and approach the truth.

Every room has meaning, and choice is soon linked to escape.

This game is not just an escape game.

Through immersive production, unique composition of entertainment shows, and details that fans can recognize

You realize the imagination of 'What if I participate in the Great Escape myself?'

  • Support for up to six-person multi-play

  • a first-person perspective

  • Mission composition that moved The Great Escape of the Korean TV Show : faithfully reproduces the order, puzzle, and spatial structure of the original episode

  • Connecting creative puzzles and clues: a variety of puzzles that require observation and reasoning as well as intuition

  • Immersive production: atmospheric sound, interaction

  • Clue combination system: the process of combining acquired items and information to approach the correct answer
